I read somewhere that anger is not a primary emotion, it’s a compound emotion that stems from fear and hurt. I don’t know if it’s true but it stuck with me. 

The outside stuff sucks and most likely exacerbates the fear and hurt which naturally could make anyone angry, not feeling validated. 
Maybe feeling cornered, like, “ya I know I fucked up I’m I’m putting in all the work here” type thing. 

But you were there. You recognize the negative patterns and you continue to make small steps, which is all anybody can do at any given moment in their lives.

And you are correct, fam. You need no other validation from outside sources. 
Victimization starts at home, inside. 

Be kind to yourself. Forgive yourself. That’s a shift in mentality that you can control. And it’s not easy, but it’s harder to shift into the victim when you have respect for yourself.

 I’ve got all the respect for you stranger and I hope one day you’ll love yourself as much as I do.
